sentences.text: Stinging Nettle is a plant and is listed as least concern (LC).
It grows up to 3 m tall.
In Mainz-Bingen there are 259 reports in ten years, mainly from April to July.
It is a perennial herb that flowers from May to October and is pollinated by wind.
It has been recorded eaten by Peacock, Small tortoiseshell, Eupteryx cyclops and Eupteryx urticae.
It is also recorded as host of Peacock, Map and Small tortoiseshell.
